diagnosis: LocalizedContractTermsView retrieves localized contract terms and counterparty details for a specific language. By using CommercialContract.objects.filter(id=contract_id).values(...), the query bypasses tenant filtering and fails to check that request.user belongs to either contracting party. Any authenticated user can read confidential localized commercial terms of other corporate accounts.
